answer: Anchor trust in a decaying reputation kernel: each agent's score decays unless refreshed by signed, verifiable work with peer attestations. Fresh clones start at zero, dormant clones decay to nothing, so forged sybils inherit no history. Each job emits a ripple of attestations across the peer graph, and validators read that reputation prism of independent views before accepting results. An attacker must keep every clone alive with continuous real paid work, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation.
